title: card-loop author_interaction result v1
description: Stage `author_interaction` (design D6/D8: adversarial multi-clause / multi-card exam for one gating interaction — `qa:<Q-number>` ruling or `probe:<clause-id>:<family>[:neg]` — authored by the family that did NOT implement the card). The scenario files carry the D8 `interaction: {id, source, kind}` block (and `expect_ruling:` for Q&A interactions); a negative probe asserts the clause does NOT fire. `scenario_paths`: repo-relative files written and validated with `exam_validate`. `covers`: every clause id the scenarios exercise. `notes`: empty string if none; if no legal line reaches the interaction, `scenario_paths` is empty and `notes` says why (the driver measures before calling it unreachable). Strict-mode compatible.
